content.text:
**Context:** Improving the daily 06:30 "Files Claude created" digest email (`~/.claude/scripts/claude-files-digest.py`) so it is actually useful.

**Key Exchanges:**
- Audit of the old email over Oct 24–30: 367 files listed, ~135 (37%) noise (forecast CSV snapshots, agent `.meta.json`, Codex review `.txt`), only 89 (24%) real docs. It read only git, so Drive deliverables (docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx) never appeared. Paths were local and unclickable. Empty "0 files" emails were sent on Oct 18 and Oct 27.
- User chose Option A (all 4 changes) over Option B (noise cut only).
- Implemented and pushed to `~/.claude` as commits `91571de` and `fe65ba2`. The first real email runs tomorrow at 06:30.
- New email layout:
  - Drive deliverables first, with links, grouped by folder, max 10 per folder.
  - Git docs with GitHub links, under their commit messages.
  - One count line per repo for data files.
  - No email on empty days.
- Verified with no-send previews: Oct 31 found the Drive docx and pdf the old email missed; Oct 30 shrank from 95 lines to 20 docs plus counts; Oct 27 (a re-filing day) collapsed 67 moved drafts to 10 per folder.
- Also wired the 21:00 `nightly-digest.py` to the same Drive lookup, since its Mac Drive section had been off.

**Decisions Made:**
- Look up Drive folder paths only for each day's few deliverables, not the whole tree (460+ folders, more than one page).
- Kept the six names `nightly-digest.py` imports from this script unchanged (`git`, `SKIP`, `already_sent`, `repos`, `send`, `MAX_BODY`) so the nightly digest does not break.
- Cap at 10 files per Drive folder to contain re-filing days.

**Lessons Learned:**
- `nightly-digest.py` imports from `claude-files-digest.py`, so check dependents before refactoring.
- Drive cannot tell who created a file, so the Drive section lists all new document files, and a moved or re-uploaded file counts as new.
- The Edit tool failed on `STATUS.md` because the file had not been read first; read before editing.
- GitHub links only open when logged in, because the repos are private.

**Action Items:**
- Check the first real 06:30 email on Oct 31's run (Nov 1 delivery) to confirm the format and the Drive section.
- No send test was done, so the first real send is the live test.
